paragraphs: Point & Pay sells payment processing for government agencies. City, county, and state taxes are one of the bill categories the site lists. Customers pay through a mobile-friendly interface that works online from any device.
The company states over 20 years in business and over 5000 government-related clients. The site describes audited, redundant, and compliant payment solutions provided in partnership with the agency.

Named clients include the Town of Westport, CT, and the Summerville Commissioners of Public Works, SC. Further named clients are Whatcom County and Pierce County in Washington, and Hamilton County, Ohio.
